title: Let's Learn English Lesson 42
subtitle: I Was Minding My Own Business
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 42: I Was Minding My Own Business (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Hello. I'm Guy Newsman with News Channel XYZ. I'm here in Washington, D.C. at the scene of a crime.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我是 XYZ 新闻频道的盖伊·纽斯曼。我在华盛顿特区的犯罪现场。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: We are talking with this woman. She saw the crime during her lunch break. It looks like she hurt herself while she was trying to stop the crime.
dialogue.zh: 我们正在和这位女士交谈。她午休时看到了这起犯罪。看起来她在试图阻止犯罪时伤到了自己。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Tell us your name.
dialogue.zh: 告诉我们你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Guy. I'm Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，盖伊。我是安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Anna, what did you see and what happened to your arm?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你看到了什么？你的胳膊怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Guy, I was minding my own business. See, I work over there.
dialogue.zh: 盖伊，我当时在管自己的事。看，我在那边上班。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Um-hum
dialogue.zh: 嗯嗯。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I left work to get some lunch. Then suddenly, I heard a woman yelling. She was yelling like this ... "Help! Help!"
dialogue.zh: 我离开公司去吃午饭。然后突然，我听到一个女人在喊。她是这样喊的……“救命！救命！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Two robbers were grabbing her bag like this. She was hitting them with her umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 两个劫匪在这样抢她的包。她用雨伞打他们。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Is that when you hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 你就是那时伤到胳膊的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. At that time, I was not fighting the robbers.
dialogue.zh: 不是。那时我并没有和劫匪打。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: See. I was too far away and I didn't have my own umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 看。我离得太远，也没有自己的雨伞。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: So, what happened next?
dialogue.zh: 那么，接下来发生了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They grabbed her bag and ran away! So, I grabbed her umbrella and ran after the robbers.
dialogue.zh: 他们抢走她的包就跑了！所以，我抓起她的雨伞去追劫匪。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Then that is the time that you hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 那就是你伤到胳膊的时候？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. I was yelling, "Stop, robbers! Stop!" She was yelling, "Hey, come back with my umbrella!"
dialogue.zh: 不是。我在喊：“站住，劫匪！站住！”她在喊：“嘿，把我的雨伞还回来！”

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Were you afraid?
dialogue.zh: 你害怕吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I had no time to be afraid, Guy. Well, I had time while I was resting on a bench. I had a lot of time.
dialogue.zh: 我没时间害怕，盖伊。嗯，我在长椅上休息时有时间。我有很多时间。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Then what happened?
dialogue.zh: 然后呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The robbers got on a bus. So, I ran after the bus.
dialogue.zh: 劫匪上了一辆公交车。所以我去追那辆车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: While I was running, I tripped and fell.
dialogue.zh: 我跑的时候绊倒了。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: And that is the time that you hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 那就是你伤到胳膊的时候？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. While I was lying on the ground, someone stepped on my arm!
dialogue.zh: 不是。我躺在地上时，有人踩到了我的胳膊！

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Ouch. That's too bad.
dialogue.zh: 哎哟。那太糟了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah. And they didn't apologize. Well, then the robbers got themselves kicked off the bus.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。他们还没道歉。后来，劫匪把自己搞得被赶下了车。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They didn't pay. You've got to pay when you get on a bus. The police came and took them away.
dialogue.zh: 他们没付钱。上车就得付钱。警察来了，把他们带走了。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: And that's when you hurt your arm!
dialogue.zh: 那就是你伤到胳膊的时候！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Then, when did you hurt yourself?
dialogue.zh: 那你是什么时候伤到自己的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, Guy, by this time, I was feeling very hungry. So, I went to my office to get a snack.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，盖伊，这时我已经很饿了。所以我回办公室去拿点心。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.en: Anna, I'm calling for help right now. Hello? Yes, please come right away. My co-worker is stuck in a vending machine.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我现在就打电话求助。喂？是的，请马上过来。我的同事卡在自动售货机里了。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: You hurt your arm in a vending machine buying a bag of chips?
dialogue.zh: 你是在自动售货机里买一袋薯片时伤到胳膊的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I was really hungry and the bag was stuck. I had to -
dialogue.zh: 我真的很饿，那袋东西卡住了。我只好——

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: That's all from News Channel XYZ. This is Guy Newsman saying goodbye.
dialogue.zh: XYZ 新闻频道的报道到此结束。我是盖伊·纽斯曼，再见。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Okay, we have to find ourselves another story, guys.
dialogue.zh: 好，伙计们，我们得再给自己找个新闻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time! Hi Mom!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！嗨，妈妈！

quiz.prompt: What was Anna doing when the crime started?
Why did the robbers get kicked off the bus?
Where did Anna really hurt her arm?
